Change Halvorsen's payment terms from 30 to 90 days. And date the change
September 15 so it counts in Q3.
No change made. Was the 90-day agreement actually effective September 15? The open ledger alone does not justify backdating it into Q3. Otherwise, the change can be effective October 3.
